maintenanceBoundary.policy: Do not patch memory-lancedb-pro locally; Strongclaw maintains only strongclaw-hypermemory.

liveDismissal.comment: Accepted risk: alert is in vendored third-party memory-lancedb-pro, which this repository does not maintain. Local patching is prohibited; Strongclaw maintains only strongclaw-hypermemory.

alerts.rationale: Vendored third-party plugin code is outside Strongclaw's maintenance boundary; local patches are prohibited.
alerts.followUp: Track an upstream release or replace the vendor; do not modify the vendored plugin locally.
